title: Legibility without destruction
summary: How can government understand what happens in a place without requiring local life to organise itself around a data return? Citizen-held measures, inquiry, assurance, and control.

title: Peter Block has a deeply irritating habit; he consistently Gives Good Guru and makes you think, damnit.
summary: Peter Block on relationships, resistance, and what our management and commissioning practices ask of people. What would change if the way we worked embodied the relationships we wanted?

title: No escape, no prison – on other perspectives on systems | cybernetics | complexity
summary: Stability, change, and the limits of our ways of seeing. A response to criticism of the six-diagram account, with the longer original essay, diagrams, and self-critique.
